mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market that will put upward pressure on wages, leading to higher inflation expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A large monthly decline in industrial production signals a supply shock that will negatively impact economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines > 1% in 1 month but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4%, an additional 25 basis point hike signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rises by 25bp but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts are below their 12-month moving average, an increase in the consumer price index signals demand-pull inflation that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month and HOUST < 12mo MA
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month and HOUST < 12mo MA but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 5%, a sharp increase in payroll employment signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS rises > 300k in 1 month
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS rises > 300k in 1 month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real estate loans signals a tightening of credit conditions that will negatively impact economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines > 5% in 1 month but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 2%, a 25 basis point cut signals a shift to an accommodative monetary policy stance that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 2% and declines by 25bp but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.
